hypotheses: SE and replicate spread scale as M^-1/2; RMSE can plateau at bias
Gaussian/constant exact discrete means exhibit trapezoid O(h^2)
Dataset h order may be unresolved with this statistical budget

purpose: Separate M, h, T at x=0; no benchmark or spatial accuracy claim

resources.estimate_basis: Prior measured F0000 13.2M updates/1.815s, F0001 /4.170s, F0002 /4.688s; one-point time-loop overhead makes extrapolation approximate
resources.stop: Stop entire study on external limit or solver failure; retain all completed/partial/not_run attempts; no automatic retries

statistical_protocol.interval: Solver: pointwise normal CI for discrete truncated expectation; aggregate: Student t across independent replicates; no total-error CI
statistical_protocol.order: At least 3 h levels; report stochastic ambiguity. Analytic oracles may establish trapezoid order only for the two analytic examples.
statistical_protocol.tuning: No removal of outliers or adjustment of M/h/T using exact errors
